{{Quote|I have tracked the bounty hunter, Jango Fett, to the droid foundries of Geonosis. The Trade Federation is to take delivery of a droid army here, and it is clear that Viceroy Gunray is behind the assassination attempts on Senator Amidala. The Commerce Guilds and the Corporate Alliance have both pledged their armies to Count Dooku and are forming a— Wait. Wait.|Obi-Wan Kenobi is cut off while delivering a message viewed by Lexi Dio|audio=Kenobi-GeonosisReport-AOTC.flac|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Lexi Dio''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[senator]] for the [[planet]] [[Uyter]] in the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Separatist Crisis]]. Dio was part of the [[Loyalist Committee]] that supported [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] and in [[22 BBY]] was in his [[Emperor's office|office]] when a message from [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from the planet [[Geonosis]] on [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] forces gathering there was played. She was later succeeded by interim senator [[Malé-Dee]].

==Biography==
[[File:KenobisReport-AOTC.png|thumb|left|300px|Lexi Dio and other Loyalist Committee members watched Obi-Wan Kenobi give a report from Geonosis while in Sheev Palpatine's office.]]
Lexi Dio was a [[human]] who served as a [[senator]] in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] during the [[Separatist Crisis]],<ref name="CVD" /> representing [[Uyter]],<ref name="Dawn" /> a [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]<ref name="Map">[[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]]</ref> [[planet]].<ref name="Aftermath">[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']]</ref> Although she was critical of the executive,<ref name="Dawn" /> Dio was a part of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] [[Loyalist Committee]], a group of senators chosen to foster support for the chancellor's rule.<ref name="CVD" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> Dio and other committee members stood with several [[Jedi]] and the chancellor himself in [[Office of the Chancellor|Palpatine's office]] on the planet [[Coruscant]] while the group watched a [[Hologram|holographic]] message from [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="AOTC" />

Kenobi was sending the message from the planet [[Geonosis]], where he had [[Dogfight over Geonosis|tracked]] the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] to a series of [[Geonosis droid factories|droid foundries]]. He reported that the [[Trade Federation]] was taking delivery of a [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]] and that Federation [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]] had been behind several recent [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|assassination]] attempts on<ref name="AOTC" /> Loyalist Committee member<ref name="CVD" /> [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]. He began explaining that the [[Corporate Alliance]] and [[Commerce Guild]] were forming an alliance with [[Count of Serenno|Count]] [[Dooku]], the head of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|separatist movement]] trying to break away from the Republic, but before Kenobi could finish, a [[droideka]] attacked the Jedi and caused the transmission to end. Shortly after viewing the message, [[Jedi assault team|Jedi]] and [[Grand Army of the Republic|Republic forces]] traveled to Geonosis to [[First Battle of Geonosis|rescue Kenobi]] from the Separatists, beginning the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="AOTC" /> By [[19 BBY]],<ref name="ROTS Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}}, in which [[Malé-Dee]] is shown as a member of the [[Galactic Senate]], to [[19 BBY]].</ref> Dio had been succeeded as representative of Uyter by the interim senator [[Malé-Dee]], who continued her criticism of the executive by signing the [[Petition of 2,000]].<ref name="Dawn" />

==Personality and traits==
Dio had light skin, [[Color|blonde]] [[hair]], and blue [[eye]]s.<ref name="CVD" />

==Equipment==
Lexi Dio wore a magenta and golden [[Clothing|dress]] made of elegant fabrics.<ref name="CVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:LexiDio-Smile-FF130.png|thumb|right|200px|Lexi Dio was portrayed by Nicole Fantl.]]
Lexi Dio was portrayed by [[Nicole Fantl]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|lexidio|Dio, Lexi}}</ref> in the [[prequel trilogy]] film {{Film|II}},<ref name="AOTC" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where [[Lexi Dio/Legends|Dio]] was first mentioned prior to the release of ''Attack of the Clones'' in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 49|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #49'']],<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|news/13328_1.html|Palpatine forms Loyalist Committee}}</ref> a [[March 28]], 2002<ref name="HNN49 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6493893|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-04-18|time=6:27 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> issue published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] website as part of the film's marketing.<ref name="HNN" /> The article was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
